questions.def: «proceed to + infinitiv» keyingi harakatga oʻtishni bildiradi.
questions.question: Having finished the report, she proceeded ___ it to her supervisor.

questions.def: «urge somebody to do» qolipi obyekt va «to»-infinitiv oladi; «insist» bunday qolip olmaydi.
questions.question: The professor ___ the students to submit their essays early.

questions.def: «yesterday» oʻtgan zamonni talab qiladi; «deny» dan keyin gerundiy (having seen) keladi.
questions.question: In court yesterday, he ___ ever having seen the document.

questions.def: «It is essential that» dan keyin subjunktiv: feʼl asos shaklda (he follow).
questions.question: It is essential that he ___ the instructions carefully.

questions.def: «regret to inform» yomon xabarni rasmiy, muloyim yetkazish qolipi.
questions.question: I regret ___ you that your application has been rejected.

questions.def: «advise against» predlogi bilan birga gerundiy keladi: against investing.
questions.question: I advised him against ___ in that company.

questions.def: «appear to be» koʻrinishini bildiradigan qolip, «to» bilan infinitiv oladi.
questions.question: He appears ___ a successful businessman.

questions.def: «decide» dan keyin «to»-infinitiv keladi: decided to postpone.
questions.question: The board decided ___ the proposal indefinitely.

questions.def: «recommend that» dan keyin subjunktiv — asos shakl «undergo» ishlatiladi.
questions.question: The doctor recommended that he ___ further tests.

questions.def: «aim to do something» maqsadni bildiruvchi qolip, «to»-infinitiv oladi.
questions.question: The company aims ___ its market share.

questions.def: «consider» dan keyin gerundiy keladi: considering moving.
questions.question: They are considering ___ their headquarters to a new location.

questions.def: «claim to do something» oʻzi haqida daʼvo qilish qolipi, «to»-infinitiv oladi.
questions.question: He claims ___ the complexities of the situation.

questions.def: «It's no use» dan keyin har doim gerundiy keladi: no use worrying.
questions.question: It's no use ___ about the past.

questions.def: «look forward to» predlogli ibora, keyin gerundiy keladi: to seeing.
questions.question: I look forward to ___ you next week.

questions.def: «learn to do» qolipi; «is + learning» hozir davom etayotgan jarayonni bildiradi.
questions.question: She is ___ to play the piano.

questions.def: «risk» feʼlidan keyin gerundiy keladi: risked losing.
questions.question: They risked ___ their savings on the project.

questions.def: «arrange to do something» kelishib qoʻyishni bildiradi, «to»-infinitiv oladi.
questions.question: We arranged ___ him at the airport.

questions.def: «Would you mind» dan keyin gerundiy keladi: mind closing.
questions.question: Would you ___ closing the window?

questions.def: «make somebody do» kauzativ qolip, «to» siz asos shakl oladi.
questions.question: He made me ___ the entire report again.

questions.def: «help somebody (to) do» qolipida asos shakl toʻgʻri; «for washing» qolipi mavjud emas.
questions.question: She helped him ___ the car.

questions.def: «to» dan keyin asos shakl «get»; «get something fixed» kauzativ qolip.
questions.question: I need to ___ my car fixed.

questions.def: «have somebody do» kauzativ qolip, «to» siz asos shakl talab qiladi.
questions.question: He had his assistant ___ the documents.

questions.def: «notice somebody doing» jarayon davom etayotganini bildiradi; «for leaving» xato.
questions.question: She noticed him ___ the room.

questions.def: «deem it necessary» dan keyin «to»-infinitiv keladi: to conduct.
questions.question: The committee deemed it necessary ___ further investigation into the matter.

questions.def: «proceed to + infinitiv» keyingi qadamga oʻtishni bildiradi: to analyse.
questions.question: Having finished the experiment, the scientist proceeded ___ the results.

questions.def: «last month» aniq oʻtmish — Past Simple «denied»; «deny» dan keyin gerundiy keladi.
questions.question: At the hearing last month, he ___ ever having met the witness.

questions.def: «It is imperative that» subjunktiv talab qiladi: «be» asos shaklda qoladi.
questions.question: It is imperative that he ___ present at the meeting tomorrow.

questions.def: «insist on + gerundiy» — «insist» faqat «on» predlogi bilan keladi.
questions.question: The professor insisted ___ submitting the assignment on time.

questions.def: «recommend that» dan keyin subjunktiv: asos shakl «stop» ishlatiladi.
questions.question: The doctor recommended that she ___ smoking immediately.

questions.def: «regret + having + V3» oʻtmishdagi ish uchun afsus bildiradi; «for saying» xato.
questions.question: He regrets ___ such harsh words during the debate.
